maddeler.e:
ننشرح (form VII)
# نَنْشَرِحُ (nanšariḥu) /nan.ʃa.ri.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# نَنْشَرِحَ (nanšariḥa) /nan.ʃa.ri.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# نَنْشَرِحْ (nanšariḥ) /nan.ʃa.riħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
